top_issues: 'H1 hub owes you +95.00' has no risk color, so you can't tell if it is enforceable or just a promise without the Manage/Sovereignty legend.
Recent mixes payment, swap and receive with only a status dot and no day/type grouping, slowing scan.
The account bar (green+purple+gray) appears without the legend that explains those colors.
fixes: Add a miniature legend 'green=yours · violet=promise · gray=room' to the Accounts card.
Group Recent by day and add a type icon per row.
Show the color legend on the first account card so the bars are self-explanatory.

top_issues: Money buckets use four labels (On-chain / Reserve / Secured / Hub promise) but Manage calls the same green money 'Yours whatever a hub does' and Sovereignty 'Enforceable right now'; a new user cannot tell they are the same bucket.
The total '$162.99' is set at near-full-bleed width and will collide with the breakdown bar on a narrower phone.
'Secured $0.00' is a distinct green category never explained next to 'Reserve'.
fixes: Replace the four bucket labels with one canonical pair 'Yours (safe)' / 'Promise (at risk)' used verbatim on Home, Manage and Sovereignty.
Cap the total type at ~72px and center it against the scale bar so it never bleeds.
Merge 'Secured' into 'Reserve' or rename to 'Collateral held' and add a one-line gloss.

top_issues: 'This payment 25.00' and 'Your account with H1 95.00' each render a bar (a plain green line vs the green/violet/gray scale), so a user can mistake which bar describes what.
'Fee 0.000050' shows five decimals, making a near-zero fee look precise and important.
fixes: Label the two bars 'This payment' vs 'Your account', color the payment bar green, and separate them with a divider.
Show the fee as '0.000050 USDC (≈ $0)' or round to fewer significant figures.

top_issues: The recipient address '0x92c2...4061 b0609737326729cb2cbf0' wraps mid-string across two lines and can look like two values.
'Up to 155.00 instantly' inside the Amount header competes with the actual amount and is easy to read as about the amount, not the route capacity.
The two routes show the same 'You send 25.00' with a tiny fee difference and no reason to pick 3 hops.
fixes: Truncate the address to '0x92c2...cbf0' on one line and expand on tap with a verified prefix.
Move capacity into the route section as 'Your route can send up to 155.00'.
Add a note: 'More hops can find better liquidity but cost more.'

top_issues: The receipt sits over the H1 account whose '+70.00 owes you' background balance competes with the receipt amount '25.00'.
'Settled 05:37:04 in 9 s' has a timing cue but no 'arrived instantly' reassurance for a novice.
fixes: Apply a stronger scrim so background balances are unintelligible until dismissed.
Add 'Arrived instantly — no waiting' under PAID to reinforce the value prop.

top_issues: The modal sits over a dimmed balance '$137.99' which a user may read as part of the receipt after a 25.00 payment.
'Proof 0x921f4bda...deb9' is truncated with no copy/expand affordance from the modal.
fixes: Dim further and add a 'balance after' caption so the underlying number reads as context, not receipt content.
Add 'Copy proof' next to 'Copy receipt' and make the proof expandable.

top_issues: 'Copy xln:// app link' is a third share method beside 'Copy invoice' and 'Copy link', diluting the primary action.
'YOUR ENTITY ID' hex has no visible copy affordance; a user must long-press.
fixes: Merge 'Copy link' and 'Copy xln:// app link' into one 'Share' and keep 'Copy invoice' as hero.
Add a copy button next to the Entity ID with a 'what this is' collapsible.

top_issues: '45.50 capacity via H1' uses 'capacity', a Lightning/credit term a first-timer will not parse.
'Note·optional · What is this for?' as a placeholder reads as a question the UI asks, not guidance.
fixes: Replace 'capacity' with 'H1 can accept up to 45.50 now' and add a tooltip.
Change the placeholder to 'Add a note (optional) — e.g. Invoice #12' so it instructs.

top_issues: The order book uses yellow/orange (asks) and green (bids), but the rest of the wallet uses green=yours and yellow=you owe on the Account page; the color semantics collide across contexts.
'Tap a level to fill the ticket' is the only interaction hint; there is no selected-level state or fill button until you tap.
fixes: Switch the book to neutral blue/red, or add a 'asks/bids' legend so it does not fight the risk colors.
Add a 'Fill 11.90 WETH at 2,501.0' preview button when a level is selected.

top_issues: 'Hub fee 1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH' — 'up to 0.0000' reads as zero and undermines the no-hidden-fee promise.
'You receive 0.039992' is grayed but nothing says it is a quote, so it reads like a locked fill.
The 100%/0% collateral row and the shortage are powerful but dense; a novice won't know they can trade without collateral.
fixes: Show 'Hub fee: 1 bps (max 0.0000 WETH)' or, if truly zero, 'No hub fee at this size'.
Label the receive amount 'Quoted best price — fills at 2,500.5000'.
Add 'If you lack collateral, H1 can still fill from credit — you pick the mix.'

top_issues: The WETH card (+0.01) is tiny and the 'every frame signed by both of you' sentence is the only risk teaching; there is no per-asset worst-case line.
'Status Open' in green implies safety while 'you owe 0.00' is a separate line.
fixes: Add a worst-case-lose line per asset and move the frame/signature explanation under 'THIS ACCOUNT'.
Tie 'Status Open' to the risk legend so green does not imply no risk.

top_issues: Dense: the USDC and WETH cards each stack 'they owe you', a 4-segment bar, credit lines, collateral and a ledger link; two in one scroll is heavy for a glance.
'Your credit line to them 115.50' and 'send up to 130.00' are not obviously related, so the bar max may be read as the credit line.
fixes: Add a summary 'You can lose at most X if H1 vanishes' per asset so no math is required.
Restate the bar header as 'route can send up to 130.00' and label credit lines separately.

top_issues: The filter chip 'Accol…' is truncated (likely 'Accounts') with no way to see the rest.
The two 'Sent -25' rows are indistinguishable without reading the 'via H1' subline.
fixes: Auto-fit filter chips to the full word and indicate the active filter on the list.
Put 'via H1' on the amount line and let the direction icon carry the sign for scannability.

top_issues: The proof hash '0x921f4bda...7bde b9' wraps mid-token, breaking the hash visually.
'Frames 2 committed entries' and 'From your runtime's committed frames' use 'runtime/committed' jargon with no gloss.
fixes: Truncate the proof cleanly to '0x921f4bda…7bdeb9' and expand on tap.
Add a tooltip 'committed = both parties signed and cannot be changed'.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' is shown as a normally-elevated button next to 'Lock' and the red 'Forget vault'; a single tap reveals a seed phrase with no confirmation.
'Mode embedded' / 'Runtime id' / 'Frame #44' are underexplained technical labels in a settings screen a novice will visit.
fixes: Put 'Reveal recovery phrase' behind a confirm and timed auto-lock, in an Advanced/Vault section.
Add a gloss for 'Runtime' and 'Embedded' (e.g., 'your local copy of the ledger').

top_issues: 'Dollars per pixel' is a precise but technical control; the Auto default hides the real scale, so a user may not realize every bar uses one scale.
The three HOME toggles (On-chain wallet / Reserve / Accounts) have no per-toggle downside note, so turning one off could surprise a user.
fixes: Under Auto, add 'Auto = one bar that scales to your largest balance' and show the numeric scale.
Add a one-line 'what you lose' under each toggle (e.g., 'Off: no instant hub payments').

top_issues: 'WHAT HAPPENS · Fund you through H1' is the only explainer; the gas/cost implication is invisible.
'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' uses 'entity' without explaining 'empty = me'.
fixes: Add expected cost/time (e.g., '~$0.01 gas · ~1 block') under WHAT HAPPENS.
Replace 'entity' with 'account/address' and add 'leave empty to pay yourself'.

top_issues: The TO cards show 0.00/40.00/130.00 but the Amount says 'up to 40.00', so the reader may think the destination (130.00) limits the move, not the source.
'Add to batch' is a powerful feature but appears as a plain secondary button with no explanation.
fixes: Annotate the selected FROM card 'source' and TO card 'destination · balance 130.00' so direction and limit are unambiguous.
Add a tooltip on 'Add to batch': 'Queue several moves into one signed frame.'

top_issues: 'Yours whatever a hub does $40.00' is the clearest framing, but it names the green bucket differently than Home ('Reserve/Secured') and Sovereignty ('Enforceable right now'); this mismatch forces the user to reconcile three names for one number.
The tiles (Sovereignty/Move/Assets/Lending/Ownership) push the risk panel below the fold even though it is the valuable part.
fixes: Use one canonical 'Yours (safe)' / 'Owed by hub' pair on Home, Manage, Sovereignty and Account.
Move 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' to the top under the title with the tiles below.

top_issues: 'Available 45.499022 USDC · Need 54.500978 USDC more' shows six-decimal precision that looks technical and implies unactionable accuracy.
Four 'receive' paths (Credit instead / Receive USDC from H1 / to wallet / gas / reserve) are stacked as similar buttons with no primary.
fixes: Round shortage figures to 2 decimals and show '≈' where estimated.
Make one primary 'Accept as credit' highlighted and demote the rest to secondary/advanced.

top_issues: 'Gas 0.1000 ETH' shows four decimals for a whole-number gas amount, implying false precision.
'Depository may pull 0.00' per token is a good transparency signal but reads as a warning without context.
fixes: Show gas as '0.1 ETH' and reserve decimals for balances.
Add a gloss 'how much the Depository may take if a settlement closes short'.

top_issues: The 'Offer to the pool' button is disabled because the amount is 0.00, but the reason is not stated, so it may read as broken.
'= 1.00% per term' is clear, but 'per term' (1 day) is not annualized, so returns cannot be compared.
fixes: Show helper text under the disabled button: 'Enter an amount to enable the offer.'
Add an annualized APR estimate next to the per-term rate.

top_issues: Lending to a hub is a counterparty risk surface, but there is no risk warning on the lend form, which conflicts with the wallet's otherwise honest risk framing.
'Hub H1 · 3 lanes' — 'lanes' is never explained, so a lender cannot tell what it means for their funds.
fixes: Add a risk callout: 'Lending is a promise from the hub; the principal carries counterparty risk, unlike the Reserve.'
Define 'lanes' with a tooltip (per-asset credit lines to the hub).

top_issues: The screen is technical ('Lazy (hash of its board)', 'EntityProvider') with no in-place gloss, so only an advanced user parses it.
'Threshold 1 of 1' and 'Signer you' are correct, but a DAO treasurer needs to know how to add a second signer; there is no action to edit the board here.
fixes: Add 'what this means' under the board (e.g., 'You sign alone; add a signer to require a quorum').
Surface a 'Change signers' action instead of only describing registration.

top_issues: 'nothing at risk' green under H1 is reassuring but sits in a per-counterparty card that implies more detail; there is no tap-through to the account.
'Runtime in this page' and 'Accounts co-signed 1 of 1' are jargon-heavy for a trust summary.
fixes: Make the counterparty row tappable to the Account screen so 'nothing at risk' can be verified.
Add a gloss for 'co-signed' (both sides signed) and 'runtime' (your local copy).

top_issues: 'Collateral behind what you are owed $0.00' appears to contradict the Account page showing 'Collateral 60.00' for the same hub; if these are different definitions the app should say so, otherwise it looks like a data error.
'Enforceable right now $40.00' is strong, but the green components are not totalled visually.
fixes: Unify the 'collateral' definition with the Account card and label any promise-not-yet-locked collateral explicitly.
Add a small stack On-chain $0 + Reserve $40 + Collateral $0 = $40 under the headline.

overall.verdict: This is a strong, genuinely differentiated product — the absolute one-scale bars, the green/violet risk legend, and the per-screen plain-language risk explanations (Sovereignty, Manage) build real trust and would satisfy power users and prosumers; the order book inside a wallet and the credit/collateral framing are compelling. It is not yet 95+ for first-timers: the money-bucket labels change across screens, the vocabulary assumes financial literacy (bps, runtime, committed frames, capacity, lanes), several flows a persona needs are thin or missing (no dispute workflow screen, no cross-network transfer screen, weak invoice framing), and a few dense/trading screens lean pro.
priority_fixes: Unify the money-bucket vocabulary and legend across Home, Manage, Sovereignty and Account — one canonical pair (green = 'Yours (safe)', violet = 'Hub promise (at risk)') repeated verbatim; today 'Secured', 'Yours whatever a hub does', 'Enforceable right now' and 'Collateral behind what you are owed' describe overlapping sets.

Add a plain-language risk gloss on the Home balance ('Green is money you cannot lose; violet is what a hub still owes you') and soften 'Hub promise' to 'Owed by hub' so a first-timer can read the top screen in seconds.

Make the receipt a forwardable artifact: add 'Copy proof' / 'Share receipt' that produces a clean self-contained string (amount, frame, hash, signatures) and expose CSV/JSON export from the Receipt, not only Activity.

Tone down jargon in the top-of-funnel: replace 'Prepare to receive', 'capacity', 'bps', 'runtime' and 'committed frames' with plain equivalents or inline tooltips on first view, keeping the precise terms on the advanced screens (Account, Swap, Ownership).

Fix the polish/data nits that undercut trust: wrap proof hashes on a clean boundary, change 'up to 0.0000 WETH' to a real cap or 'No hub fee at this size', label the two stacked bars on Pay explicitly, and truncate the filter chip 'Accol…' to 'Accounts'.
